what: MGM Resorts owns casinos and hotels: about half the Las Vegas Strip including Bellagio, MGM Grand, Aria and Mandalay Bay, regional American casinos, and half of MGM China in Macau.
customers: Las Vegas visitors, convention groups, regional casino customers and Macau gamblers.
moat: Irreplaceable Las Vegas Strip real estate and the licences to operate on it, plus a Macau concession that only six companies hold.
risks: $31.3B of debt, much of it lease obligations after selling the property to REITs
Macau depends on Chinese travel policy and consumer confidence
Las Vegas visitation has softened and a 1.2% net margin leaves little room
opportunities: 6.0 times free cash flow with $1.4B of free cash flow against an $8.5B market value
Revenue grew from $9.7B to $17.5B in four years
The company buys back a very large share of its stock each year, and BetMGM has turned profitable
watch: Las Vegas room rates and occupancy, and Macau market share.
